unction FS.ApplyAll()
        local list = {}
        for _, live in pairs(FS.Live) do list[#list + 1] = live end
        for _, live in ipairs(list) do FS.Reapply(live) end
    end

    function FS.Summary()
        local n = 0
        for _ in pairs(FS.Data.Overrides) do n += 1 end
        local custom = next(FS.Data.Global) ~= nil
        return custom, n
    end

    FS.Load()
end

-- ---------- Estudio de Toggles Flotantes: vista previa, editor y entrada en Ajustes ----------
do
    local FS = FloatingPillV5.Studio
    local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

    -- Sube el ZIndex de todo lo que cuelga de root (los flotantes usan ZIndex 3-7 fijos; el editor vive en ZIndex 300+)
    function FS.Lift(root, base)
        local function fix(o)
            if o and o.Parent and o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.ZIndex < base then o.ZIndex = o.ZIndex + base end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do fix(d) end
        local conn = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) task.defer(fix, d) end)
        root.Destroying:Connect(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end

    -- Réplica fiel de cada flotante (mismo código de construcción) para la vista previa
    -- kind: "Pill5" | "Circle" | "Pill"   ·   getDesign: diseño que está editando el estudio
    function FS.MakeSample(slot, kind, text, getDesign, zBase)
        local S = { State = false, Kind = kind }
        local holder = mk("Frame", { Parent = slot, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 })
        local glow = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 48), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -108, 0.5, -24),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3,
        })
        corner(glow, 999)
        local win, lbl, pill
        if kind == "Pill5" then
            local w = FloatingPillV5.FitWidth(text, 21)
            win = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -w / 2, 0.5, -15),
                BackgroundColor3 = FloatingPillV5.OffColor(), BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
            })
            win:SetAttribute("YYPillV5", true)
            corner(win, 999)
            local st = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = win, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0 })
            lbl = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = win, Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = text, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 21,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5,
            })
            lbl:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            pill = FloatingPillV5.Build(win, glow, lbl, st, false)
        else
            local isC = kind == "Circle"
            local w, h = isC and 64 or 200, isC and 64 or 36
            win = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -w / 2, 0.5, -h / 2),
                BackgroundColor3 = isC and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26) or Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = isC and 0.55 or 0.30, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
            })
            corner(win, 999)
            if not isC then
                mk("UIGradient", {
                    Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 250)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                    }),
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.15),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45),
                    }),
                    Rotation = 90,
                }, win)
            end
            mk("UIStroke", { Parent = win, Color = Theme.Accent, Thickness = isC and 3 or 2.5, Transparency = 0.20 })
            buildAnimatedBorder(win, Theme.Border, UDim.new(1, 0), true)
            win.Destroying:Connect(function() stopGlowTweens(tostring(win)) end)
            lbl = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = win,
                Size = isC and UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24) or UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
                Position = isC and UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12) or UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = isC and 11 or 21, TextWrapped = isC,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = isC and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5,
            })
            lbl:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        end
        S.Win, S.Label = win, lbl
        function S.Refresh(instant)
            if not win.Parent then return end
            if pill then
                pill.Apply(S.State, instant == true)
            else
                local c = S.State and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Secondary
                if instant then
                    win.BackgroundColor3 = c
                else
                    TweenService:Create(win, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = c }):Play()
                end
            end
            FS.Paint(win, S.State, instant == true)
        end
        FS.Lift(holder, zBase)
        S.Live = FS.Attach(win, kind == "Pill5" and glow or nil, lbl, nil, function() return S.State end, {
            Kind = kind,
            GetDesign = getDesign,
            Refresh = function() S.Refresh(true) end,
        })
        function S.SetText(t)
            lbl.Text = t
        end
        return S
    end

    -- Entrada en Ajustes (debajo de "Estilo de Toggle Flotante")
    function FS.BuildEntry(page, Window)
        -- cambiar Píldora/Círculo rehace la forma de los flotantes: después se vuelve a aplicar el diseño
        local baseApply = Window.ApplyFloatingStyle
        if type(baseApply) == "function" and not FS.WrappedApply then
            FS.WrappedApply = true
            Window.ApplyFloatingStyle = function(...)
                baseApply(...)
                FS.ApplyAll()
            end
        end

        local card = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = page, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 98), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9,
        })
        card:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(card, 14)
        local cs = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = card, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.15 })
        local cg = mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = cs,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, WHITE), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Accent),
            }),
        })
        TweenService:Create(cg, TweenInfo.new(4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 }):Play()

        -- mini píldora animada (dibujo de la tarjeta)
        local art = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        art:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "ToggleOn")
        corner(art, 999)
        local artStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = art, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })
        local artRing = mk("UIGradient", { Parent = artStroke, Color = FS.RAINBOW })
        TweenService:Create(artRing, TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 }):Play()
        local knob = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = art, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
        })
        corner(knob, 999)
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true, 0.5), { Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, 0) }):Play()
        local dot = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 52),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        corner(dot, 999)
        local dotStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = dot, Color = Theme.Accent, Thickness = 2 })
        dotStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 48) }):Play()

        local title = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.new(1, -196, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        title:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Estudio de Toggles Flotantes")
        title:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Floating Toggle Studio")
        title.Text = GetText("Estudio de Toggles Flotantes", "Floating Toggle Studio")
        local sub = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.new(1, -196, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 31), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        sub:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
        sub:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        sub:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Colores, imágenes, bordes, brillos, movimientos y textos para la píldora, el círculo y el combinado")
        sub:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Colors, images, borders, glows, motion and text for the pill, circle and combined toggles")
        sub.Text = GetText(sub:GetAttribute("TextSpanish"), sub:GetAttribute("TextEnglish"))
        local chip = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 66),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, TextColor3 = Theme.Accent, TextSize = 10,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = 10,
        })
        chip:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        chip:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
        chip:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(chip, 999)
        mk("UIPadding", { Parent = chip, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9) })
        function FS.RefreshEntry()
            if not chip.Parent then return end
            local custom, n = FS.Summary()
            local es = (custom and "Global: personalizado" or "Global: original") .. " · " .. n .. (n == 1 and " excepción" or " excepciones")
            local en = (custom and "Global: custom" or "Global: original") .. " · " .. n .. (n == 1 and " exception" or " exceptions")
            if not FS.HasPremium() then
                es, en = es .. " · 🔒 Premium con Studio Logos", en .. " · 🔒 Premium with Studio Logos"
            end
            chip:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
            chip:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
            chip.Text = GetText(es, en)
        end
        FS.RefreshEntry()

        local open = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = card, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 34), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText, TextSize = 13,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = 11,
        })
        open:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Abrir")
        open:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Open")
        open.Text = GetText("Abrir", "Open")
        corner(open, 10)
        RowKit.Control(open, true)
        open.TextSize = 13
        open.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
            local Main = Window.ScreenGui and Window.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
            if not Main then return end
            if not FS.UI then
                local ok, ui = pcall(FS.BuildUI, Window, Main)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[YinYang Estudio de Toggles] No se pudo abrir: " .. tostring(ui))
                    return
                end
                FS.UI = ui
            end
            FS.UI.Open()
        end)
        return card
    end

    -- ---------- kit de UI del editor (mismo estilo que el Estudio de Logos) ----------
    function FS.UIKit(K)
        local Z = K.Z
        function K.L(obj, es, en)
            obj:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
            obj:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
            obj.Text = GetText(es, en)
            return obj
        end
        function K.label(parent, es, en, size, font, role, props)
            local t = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Theme[role or "Text"] or Theme.Text,
                TextSize = size, Font = font, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = Z + 3,
            })
            t:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role or "Text")
            if role and role ~= "Text" then t:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true) end
            K.L(t, es, en)
            for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do t[k] = v end
            return t
        end
        function K.button(parent, es, en, role, props)
            local b = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = parent, BackgroundColor3 = Theme[role] or Theme.Secondary, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                TextColor3 = role == "Accent" and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text, TextSize = 12,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = Z + 4,
            })
            b:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", role or "Secondary")
            b:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role == "Accent" and "AccentText" or "Text")
            if role == "Accent" then b:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true) end
            K.L(b, es, en)
            corner(b, 10)
            for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do b[k] = v end
            RowKit.Control(b, role == "Accent")
            if role == "Accent" then
                b.TextSize = (props and props.TextSize) or 13
            elseif role and role ~= "Secondary" then
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme[role] or Theme.Secondary
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
                b:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", role)
            end
            return b
        end
        function K.pad(obj, t, l, r, b)
            mk("UIPadding", { Parent = obj, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b) })
        end
        function K.list(obj, padding, horizontal)
            return mk("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = obj, Padding = UDim.new(0, padding), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                FillDirection = horizontal and Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
                VerticalAlignment = horizontal and Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
            })
        end
        function K.fmt(v, step)
            if step >= 1 then return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end
            if step >= 0.1 then return string.format("%.1f", v) end
            return string.format("%.2f", v)
        end
        function K.box(parent, props)
            local b = mk("TextBox", {
                Parent = parent, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "", PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
                ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = Z + 4,
            })
            b:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            b:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            corner(b, 9)
            K.pad(b, 0, 10, 10, 0)
            for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do b[k] = v end
            return b
        end
        function K.placeholder(box, es, en)
            box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", es)
            box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", en)
            box.PlaceholderText = GetText(es, en)
        end

        -- chips: opts = { {valor, es, en, fuente?}, ... } · valor "_nil" = original
        function K.chips(parent, order, opts, getKey, onPick, height, autoX)
            local h = height or 28
            local row
            if autoX then
                row = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
            else
                row = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
                    Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), ScrollBarThickness = 0, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 3,
                })
            end
            K.list(row, 6, true)
            local api = { Items = {}, Row = row }
            function api.Set(key)
                local sk = tostring(key)
                for k, it in pairs(api.Items) do
                    local on = k == sk
                    it.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background
                    it.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.3
                    it.TextColor3 = on and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text
                    it:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", on and "Accent" or "Background")
                    it:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", on and "AccentText" or "Text")
                end
                api.Value = key
            end
            for i, o in ipairs(opts) do
                local b = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h - 2), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = Z + 4,
                })
                b:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
                if o[4] then
                    local okF, f = pcall(function() return Enum.Font[o[4]] end)
                    if okF and f then b.Font = f end
                end
                K.L(b, o[2], o[3])
                corner(b, 999)
                K.pad(b, 0, 11, 11, 0)
                local sc = mk("UIScale", { Parent = b, Scale = 1 })
                b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.07), { Scale = 0.9 }):Play() end)
                b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play() end)
                b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() sc.Scale = 1 end)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                    api.Set(o[1])
                    onPick(o[1])
                end)
                api.Items[tostring(o[1])] = b
            end
            if getKey then
                local function rf() api.Set(getKey()) end
                table.insert(K.refreshers, rf)
                rf()
            end
            return api
        end
        -- chips atados a un campo del diseño
        function K.fieldChips(parent, order, key, opts, height)
            return K.chips(parent, order, opts, function()
                local v = K.get(key)
                if v == nil then return "_nil" end
                return v
            end, function(v)
                if v == "_nil" then K.set(key, nil) else K.set(key, v) end
                K.changed()
            end, height)
        end
        function K.caption(parent, order, es, en)
            return K.label(parent, es, en, 10, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "TextDim", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        end

        -- deslizador con "Auto" (= original)  ·  cfg = {min, max, paso, valorAuto, unidad}
        function K.slider(parent, order, es, en, cfg, key)
            local s = { cfg = cfg }
            local holder = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
            K.label(holder, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -124, 0, 16), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            s.Value = K.label(holder, "", "", 11, Enum.Font.Code, "Accent", {
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 0),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = Z + 5,
            })
            local auto = K.button(holder, "Auto", "Auto", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 18), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -1), TextSize = 9 })
            local track = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 27), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderTrack or Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            track:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderTrack")
            corner(track, 999)
            local fill = mk("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderFill or Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 6 })
            fill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderFill")
            corner(fill, 999)
            local knob = mk("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 7 })
            corner(knob, 999)
            mk("UIStroke", { Parent = knob, Color = Theme.SliderThumb or Theme.Accent, Thickness = 2 }):SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderThumb")
            local hit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = Z + 8 })
            function s.Show(v)
                local c = s.cfg
                local shown = math.clamp(v or c[4], c[1], c[2])
                local a = (c[2] > c[1]) and (shown - c[1]) / (c[2] - c[1]) or 0
                fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1)
                knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(a, 0.5)
                fill.BackgroundTransparency = v and 0 or 0.6
                knob.BackgroundTransparency = v and 0 or 0.35
                auto.BackgroundTransparency = v and 0.1 or 0.75
                if v then
                    s.Value:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", nil)
                    s.Value:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", nil)
                    s.Value.Text = K.fmt(v, c[3]) .. (c[5] or "")
                else
                    K.L(s.Value, "Auto", "Auto")
                end
            end
            function s.At(x)
                local a0, w = track.AbsolutePosition.X, track.AbsoluteSize.X
                if w <= 0 then return end
                local c = s.cfg
                local v = c[1] + math.clamp((x - a0) / w, 0, 1) * (c[2] - c[1])
                v = math.floor((v - c[1]) / c[3] + 0.5) * c[3] + c[1]
                v = tonumber(string.format("%.3f", math.clamp(v, c[1], c[2])))
                if v ~= s.last then
                    s.last = v
                    K.set(key, v)
                    s.Show(v)
                    K.changed()
                end
            end
            hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if K.isPress(input) then
                    K.activeSlider = s
                    s.last = nil
                    K.Content.ScrollingEnabled = false
                    TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20) }):Play()
                    s.At(input.Position.X)
                end
            end)
            auto.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                K.set(key, nil)
                s.Show(nil)
                K.changed()
            end)
            s.Knob = knob
            s.Holder = holder
            table.insert(K.refreshers, function() s.Show(K.get(key)) end)
            s.Show(K.get(key))
            return s
        end

        -- muestra de color tocable (abre el selector) + botón para volver al color original
        function K.swatch(parent, order, es, en, key, resetEs, resetEn)
            local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
            K.label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            local sw = mk("TextButton", { Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, 0), Text = "", ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            corner(sw, 8)
            mk("UIStroke", { Parent = sw, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.4 })
            local tag = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = sw, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextColor3 = WHITE,
                TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4, ZIndex = Z + 6,
            })
            tag:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            local reset = K.button(row, resetEs or "Original", resetEn or "Original", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
            local function cur() return arrayToColor(K.get(key), nil) end
            local function refresh()
                local c = cur()
                sw.BackgroundColor3 = c or Theme.Accent
                sw.BackgroundTransparency = c and 0 or 0.6
                if c then
                    tag:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", nil)
                    tag:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", nil)
                    tag.Text = ""
                else
                    K.L(tag, "AUTO", "AUTO")
                end
                reset.BackgroundTransparency = c and 0.1 or 0.75
            end
            sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                local before = K.getRaw(key)
                K.openPicker(es, en, cur() or Theme.Accent, function(c)
                    K.set(key, colorToArray(c))
                    refresh()
                    K.changed()
                end, function(c)
                    K.set(key, colorToArray(c))
                    refresh()
                    K.changed()
                end, function()
                    K.setRaw(key, before)
                    refresh()
                    K.changed()
                end)
            end)
            reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                K.set(key, nil)
                refresh()
                K.changed()
            end)
            table.insert(K.refreshers, refresh)
            refresh()
            return row
        end

        -- ID de imagen con estado de carga (igual que las capas del Estudio de Logos)
        function K.asset(parent, order, es, en, key)
            local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
            K.label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            local pill = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), TextColor3 = WHITE,
                TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = Z + 5,
            })
            pill:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(pill, 999)
            K.pad(pill, 0, 8, 8, 0)
            local thumbBox = mk("Frame", { Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 21), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 236), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
            corner(thumbBox, 8)
            local thumb = mk("ImageLabel", { Parent = thumbBox, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
            local box = K.box(row, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -124, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 21) })
            K.placeholder(box, "ID de la imagen", "Image ID")
            local clr = K.button(row, "Quitar", "Remove", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 32), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 21), TextSize = 10 })
            local token = 0
            local function show(es2, en2, color, my)
                if token ~= my or not pill.Parent then return end
                K.L(pill, es2, en2)
                pill.BackgroundColor3 = color
            end
            local function check(url)
                token += 1
                local my = token
                thumb.Image = url
                if url == "" then
                    show("Sin imagen", "No image", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), my)
                    return
                end
                show("Cargando...", "Loading...", Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 40), my)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local result = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ url }, function(_, status) result = status end)
                    end)
                    if result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                        show("Lista", "Ready", Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 90), my)
                    elseif result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure then
                        show("No carga", "Not loading", Color3.fromRGB(205, 60, 70), my)
                    else
                        show("Sin respuesta", "No answer", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), my)
                    end
                end)
            end
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                local a = FS.CleanAsset(box.Text)
                K.set(key, a ~= "" and a or nil)
                box.Text = a
                check(a)
                K.changed()
            end)
            clr.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.35)
                K.set(key, nil)
                box.Text = ""
                check("")
                K.changed()
            end)
            table.insert(K.refreshers, function()
                local v = K.get(key) or ""
                if not box:IsFocused() then box.Text = v end
                check(v)
            end)
            return row
        end

        -- secciones: título + "Original/Usar global" + tarjeta
        function K.section(order, es, en, subEs, subEn, keys, premium)
            local h = mk("Frame", { Parent = K.Content, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order * 2, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
            local bar = mk("Frame", { Parent = h, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
            bar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(bar, 2)
            K.label(h, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0) })
            K.label(h, subEs, subEn, 9, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextDim", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 20) })
            if keys then
                local r = K.button(h, "Original", "Original", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(94, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
                table.insert(K.refreshers, function()
                    if K.ED.scope then K.L(r, "Usar global", "Use global") else K.L(r, "Original", "Original") end
                end)
                r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
                    K.resetKeys(keys)
                    if K.ED.scope then
                        K.setStatus("Sección vuelta al diseño global", "Section back to the global design", Theme.Accent)
                    else
                        K.setStatus("Sección vuelta al diseño original", "Section back to the original design", Theme.Accent)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local wrap = K.Content
            if premium then
                -- la tarjeta va dentro de un marco sin layout, así la tapa del candado puede ir encima
                wrap = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = K.Content, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order * 2 + 1, ZIndex = Z + 2,
                })
            end
            local c = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = wrap, Size = UDim2.new(1, premium and 0 or -4, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = order * 2 + 1, ZIndex = Z + 2,
            })
            c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(c, 14)
            stroke(c, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.65)
            K.pad(c, 10, 10, 10, 10)
            K.list(c, 8)
            if premium then K.lockCover(wrap) end
            return c
        end
        -- tapa con candado sobre una sección premium (tocarla abre la hoja premium)
        function K.lockCover(parent)
            local cover = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 20,
            })
            cover:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(cover, 14)
            local cs = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = cover, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90), Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.2 })
            mk("UIGradient", { Parent = cs, Rotation = 45, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)) })
            local chip = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = cover, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -12), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 34, 8),
                TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = Z + 21,
            })
            chip:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            K.L(chip, "🔒 PREMIUM", "🔒 PREMIUM")
            corner(chip, 999)
            K.pad(chip, 0, 12, 12, 0)
            mk("UIGradient", { Parent = chip, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)) })
            K.label(cover, "Incluido en el pase Yin Yang Studio Logos · tocá para verlo", "Included in the Yin Yang Studio Logos pass · tap to see it", 10, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 6),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = Z + 21,
            })
            cover.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() K.showPremium() end)
            table.insert(K.refreshers, function() cover.Visible = not FS.HasPremium() end)
            cover.Visible = not FS.HasPremium()
            return cover
        end
    end

    -- ---------- selector de color (mismo sistema que el creador de temas) ----------
    function FS.UIPicker(K)
        local Z = K.Z
        local PK = { H = 0, S = 0, V = 1 }
        K.PK = PK
        local ov = mk("Frame", { Parent = K.Panel, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, Visible = false, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 60 })
        corner(ov, 16)
        local pp = mk("Frame", { Parent = ov, Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 236), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 61 })
        pp:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(pp, 14)
        stroke(pp, Theme.Stroke, 1.4, 0.2)
        PK.Title = K.label(pp, "Color", "Color", 14, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10), ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        PK.Area = mk("Frame", { Parent = pp, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 140), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 38), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        corner(PK.Area, 8)
        local white = mk("Frame", { Parent = PK.Area, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 63 })
        corner(white, 8)
        mk("UIGradient", { Parent = white, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
        local black = mk("Frame", { Parent = white, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 64 })
        corner(black, 8)
        mk("UIGradient", { Parent = black, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0)), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }) })
        PK.Handle = mk("Frame", { Parent = PK.Area, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 65 })
        corner(PK.Handle, 999)
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PK.Handle, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })
        PK.Hue = mk("Frame", { Parent = pp, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 140), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0, 38), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        corner(PK.Hue, 8)
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = PK.Hue, Rotation = 90,
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.17, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.67, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.83, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
            }),
        })
        PK.HueHandle = mk("Frame", { Parent = PK.Hue, Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 0, 5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 65 })
        corner(PK.HueHandle, 3)
        PK.Swatch = mk("Frame", { Parent = pp, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 46), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 38), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        corner(PK.Swatch, 10)
        stroke(PK.Swatch, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.3)
        PK.Hex = mk("TextBox", { Parent = pp, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 92), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Code, ClearTextOnFocus = false, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        PK.Hex:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        PK.Hex:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        corner(PK.Hex, 8)
        local quick = mk("Frame", { Parent = pp, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 48), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 130), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
        mk("UIGridLayout", { Parent = quick, CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
        local cancel = K.button(pp, "Cancelar", "Cancel", "Secondary", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -44), ZIndex = Z + 63 })
        local apply = K.button(pp, "Aplicar", "Apply", "Accent", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 6, 1, -44), ZIndex = Z + 63, TextSize = 12 })
        local function toHex(c)
            return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
        end
        local function fromHex(s)
            s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("#", ""):gsub("%s", "")
            if not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end
            return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
        end
        function PK.color() return Color3.fromHSV(PK.H, PK.S, PK.V) end
        function PK.refresh()
            local c = PK.color()
            PK.Area.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(PK.H, 1, 1)
            PK.Handle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(PK.S, 1 - PK.V)
            PK.HueHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, PK.H)
            PK.Swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
            if not PK.Hex:IsFocused() then PK.Hex.Text = toHex(c) end
            if PK.onLive then PK.onLive(c) end
        end
        function PK.set(c)
            local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
            if s > 0.001 then PK.H = h end
            PK.S, PK.V = s, v
            PK.refresh()
        end
        for i, c in ipairs({
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 82), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 70),
            Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(60, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(90, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255),
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 200), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
        }) do
            local q = mk("TextButton", { Parent = quick, BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = Z + 63 })
            corner(q, 999)
            mk("UIStroke", { Parent = q, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.5 })
            q.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() PK.set(c) end)
        end
        function K.pickAt(pos)
            if PK.drag == "SV" then
                local a, s = PK.Area.AbsolutePosition, PK.Area.AbsoluteSize
                if s.X <= 0 or s.Y <= 0 then return end
                PK.S = math.clamp((pos.X - a.X) / s.X, 0, 1)
                PK.V = math.clamp(1 - (pos.Y - a.Y) / s.Y, 0, 1)
            elseif PK.drag == "H" then
                local a, s = PK.Hue.AbsolutePosition, P
